judgment.notes: N003 applies at the arbitrary real exponent 0<s<1. N001 applies to A=F⊆R^(n+1), m=n+1 and s>0, turning H^s(F)=infinity into dim_H(F)≥s. The metric computation uses precisely D006. The background facts have the stated positive-exponent and nonnegative extended-order premises. There are no external E applications.

H002 supplies x_0. The product metric makes f distance preserving, also for n=0. Pulling any delta-cover of F back to I gives a countable cover with no larger diameters or costs; infimum and supremum comparison yield H^s(I)≤H^s(F). N003 and N001 then give dim_H(F)≥s for every 0<s<1. The endpoint order argument yields ≥1, and D=0 gives 1=D+1 even with D initially extended-valued. No measurable-cover assumption or exchange of limits is required.
